gap_stress.fill_model_gap_handling: Backtest uses the next provider bar open and does not model auction queue, delayed official opens, partial fills, or limit misses.
gap_stress.recommended_gap_filter: Skip and hold prior weights when absolute gap exceeds 2.5%; validate threshold only with matched official-open TCA.

capacity_assessment.notes: No portfolio notional, official-open volume, quoted spread, or matched order ledger exists.

paper_simulator_limitations: Alpaca Paper omits market impact, latency slippage, queue position, price improvement, fees, and dividends.
Nasdaq and NYSE official opens can differ from generic bar timestamps and can be delayed by symbol.
A paper order lifecycle pass would not validate live net return or capacity.
